wordings.ELEMENTWISE_MAP_SENTENCE: An elementwise map. Every value x of the input is replaced by the value y the formula gives at it.
wordings.CAST_EVERY_VALUE_ROUNDED_SENTENCE: Every value is replaced by the nearest number the written format holds.
wordings.CAST_BITS_AGAINST_PHRASE: holds an element in {written_bits} bits against the {read_bits} of the operand's format
wordings.CAST_FEWER_BITS_SENTENCE: The written format {against}, so every value is replaced by the nearest number the written format holds.
wordings.CAST_MORE_BITS_SENTENCE: The written format {against}, and holds every number that format holds, so no value changes.
wordings.CAST_SAME_BITS_SENTENCE: The two formats hold an element in the same number of bits and hold different numbers, so a value the written format does not hold is replaced by its nearest number.
wordings.SCALE_SENTENCE: One scale held in {form} is shared by every {group}, and the value denoted by an element is the element multiplied by the scale of its group.
wordings.CAST_READS_SENTENCE: The cast reads a value held in {read} and writes it in {written}.
wordings.CAST_WIRE_LABEL_SENTENCE: The wire on each side of the cast is labelled with its quantisation.
